verdict.rationale: Poke is an AI assistant that runs inside messaging apps. Its docs say it performs actions across connected apps and services "through natural conversation", and that users can set reminders "naturally" and describe the charts they want, so natural-language commands are the product's primary interface. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language task execution across integrations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Once connected, Poke can access information and perform actions across apps and services through natural conversation.
Poke is your AI assistant that lives in Apple Messages, Telegram, WhatsApp, and RCS.
Reminders - Set and manage reminders naturally
Describe what you want to see, or share images of existing data (like spreadsheets) for Poke to extract and visualize.
